title: typo3-visual-editor: the skill at work
description: Templates ready for editing on the page. Recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab: a real Desiderio template, then the Visual Editor on a test page, saved for real and removed afterwards. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 47 seconds: the typo3-visual-editor agent skill. A Desiderio Fluid template renders three fields with f:render.text, and in the TYPO3 Visual Editor a headline is typed into on the page and saved. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A typo on the page meant finding the record in the backend, opening its form and saving.
You ask for editing on the page.
The skill traces each output to its record and field; f:render.text makes it editable.
In the Visual Editor: click the headline, type, save. The record is updated.
Readiness is tested as an editor, never only as admin.
